description: Single story rear extension (Demolition of ground floor rear bay windows)
decision_conditions:
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:115%;
font-family:&quot;Aptos&quot;,sans-serif;mso-ascii-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-fareast-font-family:
Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-hansi-theme-font:minor-latin;
mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-bidi-theme-font:minor-bidi;
mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA">The
proposed development due to its excessive scale and bulk and unsympathetic
design would give rise to an unduly obtrusive and incongruous extension which
would fail to respect the scale of the subject dwelling and would not preserve
and enhance the character and appearance of the locally listed building, to the
detriment of the character and appearance of the host building, locality and
the visual amenities of the neighbouring occupiers, contrary to the high
quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024),
Policies D3 D.1, D.11,D.12 and D.7 and HC1 of the London Plan (2021), Core
Policy CS1 (B) and D of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012, policies DM 1 &nbsp;and
DM 7 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the
adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></p>
